visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a voluminous black afro and a prominent eagle tattoo on his chest is standing in a shower. He is shirtless and leaning forward, holding a silver showerhead in his left hand while extending his right hand to feel the stream. The background consists of vertical tiles with a chevron texture in beige and cream tones. To his right, a metal rack holds various hygiene products, including a white bottle labeled 'GUARD'. (2) The camera cuts to a slightly different angle as the man continues to struggle with the water temperature. He adjusts the chrome faucet handle with a pained facial expression, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth as if reacting to the cold. He briefly examines his reflection in a small circular mirror attached to the shower fixture, his brow furrowed in concentration. (3) A second man with short bleached-blonde hair and a light beard enters the frame from the left, positioned behind the first man's shoulder. He wears a black graphic t-shirt and leans close to the first man's ear, whispering something. The first man reacts by freezing in place, his expression shifting from frustration to shock, then to a look of profound, exaggerated sadness. (4) The scene shifts as the first man now holds the showerhead close to his face like a microphone. He is visibly 'crying' with a distorted, grieving face, though no real tears are visible. The blonde man remains behind him, looking directly at the camera with a smug, knowing smile. Large white subtitles with black outlines appear across the center and bottom of the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sound starts with the distinct, splashing texture of water hitting a plastic or tile surface. A male voice shouts 'Hao bing o!' (So cold!) with high vocal arousal and a sharp, rising pitch contour. The speech is loud and projected, drowning out the soft ambient room tone of the bathroom. (2) The primary male voice continues a series of complaints with a fast speech rate and high pitch variability, mimicking the shivering or gasping reaction to cold water. The water splashing sound remains a constant background layer. There is a metallic click as a handle is adjusted, followed by more vocalized frustration. (3) A new, lower-pitched male voice enters the mix, whispering with a breathy texture and calm, low-arousal delivery. The first voice suddenly goes quiet, creating a moment of strategic silence where only the faint sound of falling water is audible. (4) A sentimental background music track featuring a melancholic piano melody and soaring strings suddenly swells in volume. The first male voice erupts into a series of loud, elongated wailing sounds and fake sobbing, exhibiting high vocal tension and exaggerated emotional valence. The music has a slow tempo and a minor/aeolian modal feel, reinforcing the mock-sadness.

The intent is to entertain through situational irony and melodramatic exaggeration, transitioning from a relatable mundane annoyance to a parody of heartbreak.
